title: Knowledge organiser: Revision cycle 1
subject: Business
source: Seeded from business/y11 lessons 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38 (Knowledge organiser (pupil PDF))
intro: Revision cycle 1: the big ideas, key words and examples on one sheet. Keep it in your book and use it to revise (cover, write, check).

panels.title: Big questions
points: Exams reward knowledge used in context. What is the difference between knowing a term and using it about the business in the case?
A business cannot control the exchange rate, interest rates or new laws. So why study them?
A new manager is needed. Should the business promote someone it knows or bring in someone new?
Would you work harder for more pay, or for praise and responsibility? Does it depend on the person?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah says: 'And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance' (Al-Isra' 17:35). Honest dealing is the foundation of every business decision we study.
